datasets.name: today_vs_normal
queryLines:
WITH active AS (
  SELECT
    city_id
  FROM
    simulator.demo_active_city
  WHERE
    id = 1
),
live_orders AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    session_id,
    city,
    status,
    kind,
    late_min,
    updated_at
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY _sort_by DESC) AS rn
      FROM
        catastrophe_lakebase.lb_orders_history
    ) o
  WHERE
    rn = 1
    AND _pg_change_type IN ('insert', 'update_postimage')
),
latest AS (
  SELECT
    session_id,
    city
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        o.session_id,
        o.city,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          ORDER BY
            CASE
              WHEN o.city = a.city_id THEN 0
              ELSE 1
            END,
            o.updated_at DESC
        ) AS rn
      FROM
        live_orders o
          CROSS JOIN active a
    )
  WHERE
    rn = 1
),
live AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS orders,
    ROUND(
      100.0
        * AVG(
          CASE
            WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        ),
      1
    ) AS cancel_pct,
    ROUND(
      100.0
        * AVG(
          CASE
            WHEN status IN ('stuck', 'rerouted') THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        ),
      1
    ) AS disrupted_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(late_min), 1) AS avg_late_min
  FROM
    live_orders
  WHERE
    session_id
      = (
        SELECT
          session_id
        FROM
          latest
      )
),
hist AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(
      100.0
        * AVG(
          CASE
            WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        ),
      1
    ) AS cancel_pct,
    ROUND(
      100.0
        * AVG(
          CASE
            WHEN disrupted THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        ),
      1
    ) AS disrupted_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(late_min), 1) AS avg_late_min
  FROM
    simulator.catastrophe_hist_orders h
      JOIN latest l
        ON h.city_id = l.city
)
SELECT
  'today (this run)' AS period,
  l.orders,
  l.cancel_pct,
  l.disrupted_pct,
  l.avg_late_min
FROM
  live l
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'normal (90-day avg)' AS period,
  CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
  h.cancel_pct,
  h.disrupted_pct,
  h.avg_late_min
FROM
  hist h

    kind,

  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY _sort_by DESC) AS rn
      FROM
        catastrophe_lakebase.lb_orders_history
    ) o
  WHERE

    AND _pg_change_type IN ('insert', 'update_postimage')
),
latest AS (
  SELECT
    session_id,
    city
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        o.session_id,
        o.city,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          ORDER BY
            CASE
              WHEN o.city = a.city_id THEN 0
              ELSE 1
            END,
            o.updated_at DESC
        ) AS rn
      FROM
        live_orders o
          CROSS JOIN active a
    )

SELECT
  kind_label,
  ROUND(
    100.0
      * SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN disrupted THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
      )
      / COUNT(*),
    1
  ) AS disruption_rate,
  ROUND(
    100.0
      * SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
      )
      / COUNT(*),
    1
  ) AS cancel_rate,
  ROUND(AVG(order_value), 2) AS avg_order_value,
  COUNT(*) AS total_orders
FROM
  simulator.catastrophe_hist_orders h
    JOIN latest l
      ON h.city_id = l.city
GROUP BY
  kind_label

datasets.name: revenue_at_risk
queryLines:
WITH active AS (
  SELECT
    city_id
  FROM
    simulator.demo_active_city
  WHERE
    id = 1
),
live_orders AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    session_id,
    city,
    status,
    kind,
    late_min,
    updated_at
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY _sort_by DESC) AS rn
      FROM
        catastrophe_lakebase.lb_orders_history
    ) o
  WHERE
    rn = 1
    AND _pg_change_type IN ('insert', 'update_postimage')
),
latest AS (
  SELECT
    session_id,
    city
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        o.session_id,
        o.city,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          ORDER BY
            CASE
              WHEN o.city = a.city_id THEN 0
              ELSE 1
            END,
            o.updated_at DESC
        ) AS rn
      FROM
        live_orders o
          CROSS JOIN active a
    )
  WHERE
    rn = 1
),
hist_val AS (
  SELECT
    city_id,
    kind,
    ROUND(AVG(order_value), 2) AS avg_order_value
  FROM
    simulator.catastrophe_hist_orders
  GROUP BY
    city_id,
    kind
),
live_open AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.city,
    o.status,
    o.kind AS kind_label,
    CASE o.kind
      WHEN 'Hot food' THEN 'hot'
      WHEN 'Groceries' THEN 'grocery'
      WHEN 'Ice cream' THEN 'ice'
      WHEN 'Frozen' THEN 'frozen'
    END AS kind_code
  FROM
    live_orders o
  WHERE
    o.session_id
      = (
        SELECT
          session_id
        FROM
          latest
      )
    AND o.status IN ('placed', 'routing', 'enroute', 'stuck', 'late', 'rerouted')
)
SELECT
  lo.status,
  lo.kind_label AS item,
  COUNT(*) AS orders_at_risk,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(h.avg_order_value, 20.00)), 2) AS est_revenue_at_risk
FROM
  live_open lo
    LEFT JOIN hist_val h
      ON h.city_id = lo.city
      AND h.kind = lo.kind_code
GROUP BY
  ROLLUP(lo.status, lo.kind_label)
ORDER BY
  lo.status NULLS LAST,
  est_revenue_at_risk DESC

  FROM
    simulator.demo_active_city
  WHERE
    id = 1
),
live_orders AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    session_id,
    city,
    status,
    kind,
    late_min,
    updated_at
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY _sort_by DESC) AS rn
      FROM
        catastrophe_lakebase.lb_orders_history
    ) o
  WHERE
    rn = 1
    AND _pg_change_type IN ('insert', 'update_postimage')
),
latest AS (
  SELECT
    session_id,
    city
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        o.session_id,
        o.city,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          ORDER BY
            CASE
              WHEN o.city = a.city_id THEN 0
              ELSE 1
            END,
            o.updated_at DESC
        ) AS rn
      FROM
        live_orders o
          CROSS JOIN active a
    )
  WHERE
    rn = 1
)
SELECT
  order_date,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN disrupted THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS disrupted_orders,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS cancelled_orders,
  ROUND(SUM(order_value), 2) AS total_revenue,
  ROUND(AVG(late_min), 1) AS avg_late_min
FROM
  simulator.catastrophe_hist_orders h
    JOIN latest l
      ON h.city_id = l.city
GROUP BY
  order_date
ORDER BY
  order_date
